description: Connects a book review, published as a site.standard.document, to the book it reviews.

main.description: One per reviewed book. The record key is the book's BookHive ID (hiveId), so a reader's review of a book can be found with a single getRecord.

document.description: The site.standard.document that holds the review. Its content is the formatted review; its textContent is the same review as plain text.

book.description: The reader's buzz.bookhive.book record for the book. Its review field holds the same review as plain text.

hiveId.description: The book's BookHive ID. Also the record key.

spoiler.description: The reader marked the review as giving away parts of the book. The document carries the same mark as a "spoiler" self-label.

langs.description: The languages the review is written in, as the reader chose them. BCP-47 codes, as in a Bluesky post's langs.
